title: Shared with Monize
subtitle: Nothing is saved until you choose where these files go.
unavailableHint: This file is no longer on this device.

reasons.unsupported: Monize cannot use this kind of file
reasons.tooMany: Over the limit of {max} files in one share
reasons.shareTooLarge: The share was larger than {max} in total

newTransactionHint: Create a transaction with {count, plural, one {this file} other {these files}} attached.
importHint: Open the import wizard so you can map the columns and review every row first.
sendToAssistantHint: Open the assistant with {count, plural, one {this file} other {these files}} attached, so you can ask about {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} before anything is saved.
discardConfirmMessage: The shared files will be removed from this device. Nothing in Monize changes.
attached: Transaction created with the shared files
mixedTitle: Receipts and statements need separate shares
mixedMessage: This share mixes files to attach with files to import, and the two go to different places. Share them separately and Monize can offer the right destination for each.
noneTitle: Monize could not use any of these files
noneMessage: Each file is listed above with the reason. Images and PDFs can be attached to a transaction; CSV, OFX, QFX and QIF files can be imported.
emptyTitle: That share arrived without any files
emptyMessage: Try sharing again, choosing the files before you pick Monize.
notFoundMessage: This share has already been used, was discarded, or expired. Shared files are kept on this device for an hour.
expiredMessage: Monize keeps shared files on this device for an hour, then removes them. Share them again to pick up where you left off.
missedTitle: Those files did not reach Monize
missedMessage: Monize needs to have been opened at least once on this device before the share menu can hand it files. Open Monize, then share again.
errorTitle: Monize could not hold on to those files
errorMessage: The share could not be read, or this device had no room to keep it. Share again, or add the files from inside Monize.
unsupportedBrowserTitle: This browser cannot receive shared files
unsupportedBrowserMessage: Sharing into an installed app is not available here. You can still add files from inside Monize.
noticeTitle: {count, plural, one {# file was} other {# files were}} shared with Monize
